title: StratFL: Countering Covert Model Poisoning Attacks with Strategic Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advanced persistent threats (APTs) are a major concern in federated learning (FL) deployments in critical sectors such as healthcare, and finance. Traditional defense mechanisms fail to contain APTs due to their intermittent attacking behavior. This paper addresses a specific type of APT called covert model poisoning (CMP) where the attacker intermittently injects poisoned model updates in a covert manner. The interaction between the FL server and a CMP attacker is modeled as an imperfect repeated game where both players cannot observe each other's actions. A novel adversarial search algorithm called StratFL is designed alongside novel belief update algorithms at both the server and adversary. Experiments are designed using MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets to evaluate and compare StratFL's performance against state-of-the-art methods. translated_title: StratFL：利用策略性联邦学习对抗隐蔽模型投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 高级持续性威胁（APT）是医疗和金融等关键领域联邦学习（FL）部署中的重大安全隐忧。由于APT具有间歇性的攻击行为，传统防御机制难以对其进行遏制。本文针对一种称为隐蔽模型投毒（CMP）的特定APT类型展开研究，该攻击中攻击者以隐蔽方式间歇性地注入被投毒的模型更新。本文将联邦学习服务器与CMP攻击者之间的交互建模为一种不完全信息重复博弈，即博弈双方均无法观察到对方的行动。论文设计了一种名为StratFL的新型对抗搜索算法，并在服务器端和攻击者端分别设计了新型信念更新算法。实验采用MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集设计，以评估和比较StratFL与最先进方法的性能，并在多种安全场景中验证了信念更新算法的经验收敛性。
tldr: 本文提出StratFL，将联邦学习服务器与隐蔽模型投毒攻击者的交互建模为不完全信息重复博弈，通过新型对抗搜索算法与信念更新算法有效防御间歇性隐蔽模型投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StratFL, which models the interaction between an FL server and a covert model poisoning attacker as an imperfect repeated game, employing novel adversarial search and belief update algorithms to effectively counter intermittent covert model poisoning attacks.
